summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) furnished a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its subsidiary Eco Wave Power U.S. Inc. signed a three-year non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with WISeQey Corp., SEALSQ Corp. and SEALCOIN AG. No price, stake, consideration or capital terms are stated. The parties demonstrated two proof-of-concept capabilities at the Jaffa Port installation: a trusted digital twin of energy production and authenticated automated transactions. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The MoU is exploratory, covering potential renewable-energy supply to AI data centers, aggregators and utilities. Watch for conversion into definitive commercial contracts; absent binding economics, no deal or arbitrage angle exists.
